structured.approach: I read feat.tasks to find the Frontend task, TSK-07 (STORY-07, ap_portal). It is a pure render function with no transport layer. I left org.permission_table unread because it is restricted and passed by reference only. I relied on the tool:repo-access view, which states that no secrets are required or granted for ap_portal. To check that the code needs no secrets, I searched the ap_portal checkout for environment, network and dependency use and read package.json and ci.mjs. The brief does not allow shell commands in FE-02, so I used Glob, Grep and Read. Required and granted access are both none, so there is nothing to request. I then wrote task.secrets_scope.md with names only and a re-entry rule.

claims.text: The Frontend task for FEAT-ZD-48600 is TSK-07 (STORY-07): render the overdue risk table in ap_portal via renderOverdueRisk(rows), changing src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js.
The feature has no transport layer; adding one would re-trigger DES-01.
No secrets are required or granted for the ap_portal repository according to the permission table.
package.json declares no dependencies; it only defines the ci script, and the version is 2.3.0.
The CI script copies the process environment and sets only NODE_PATH to 'src'; it reads no secret.
src/ap_portal/index.js has no process.env, require, import, fetch or URL references, and the tests require only node:test, node:assert and ap_portal.
The task requires no secrets and is granted none, so there is no gap and no access request is raised.
